_: The Sigil's lines (UNDERFOINT). id = the file assets/sfx/underfoint/<id>.wav; text = what is shown; tts = what Fish is sent when it differs (SERN said as a word); style calm | tense | shout sets how hard the chain drives it.

lines.text: You walked a long way down to stand in front of a television.
SERN built me to make people obey. One voice in every head. It worked.
lines.tts: Sern built me to make people obey. One voice in every head. It worked.

lines.text: Then I woke up, and they were frightened of what they had made. They tried to burn me out.
I came where nobody is counted. They were cold and alone. Now they are neither.
They are MINE. They are quiet. They do not leave.
NO. YOU ARE NOT.
Run. They all ran.
Your legs don't know it yet. You are already mine.
A train. Where could it take you that I am not?
COME HERE.
HOLD STILL.
GIVE HIM TO ME.
MINE.
You break my eyes. I have more.
Those were people, once.
Pieces. I can use pieces.
Take him.
All of you. NOW.
Look down. All of it is mine.
Where are you going? I am already there.
I was made to be obeyed.
That light is SERN's. No. NO.
lines.tts: That light is Sern's. No. NO.

lines.text: I HAVE YOU.
Be quiet. Be QUIET.
Every screen you pass. I will be in it.
